title: Mother & Daughter, Backyard Patio Umbrella - Vintage 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A sunny outdoor snapshot capturing a mother and her young daughter relaxing in wooden folding lawn chairs in a residential backyard. A fringed patio umbrella shades the area behind them next to a rustic shingled home entry and garden path. The mother wears a casual short-sleeved plaid button-down shirt and light shorts, while the child sits barefoot wearing summer play overalls and a hair ribbon, embodying mid-20th-century suburban domestic leisure.
